headline: Pakistan continues fuel support benefiting more than 9 million vehicle owners
summary: Pakistan is continuing its fuel subsidy for low-income drivers, with motorcycle, three-wheeler and small car owners receiving 500 rupees weekly. More than 9 million vehicle owners have benefited.
why: Fuel subsidies affect household spending, government finances and inflation, which matter for investors in Pakistan's economy and its debt.
